methods.name: Tissue Detection
methods.description: Iteratively applies Gaussian smoothing to identify tissue regions in a WSI to confine analysis and reduce computational effort.

methods.name: Tissue detector
methods.description: Iteratively applies Gaussian smoothing and Otsu thresholding until the mean of non-tissue pixels is below a threshold.

methods.name: Nuclei detection
methods.description: Segments and locates nuclei in H&E images using checkpoints for the HoVerNet model trained on PanNuke and MoNuSac datasets.

methods.name: Tissue Component Detection
methods.description: Unsupervised superpixel-based approach where tissue is oversegmented into homogeneous superpixels using Simple Linear Iterative Clustering (SLIC) and neighboring superpixels are hierarchically merged using color similarity.

methods.name: GraphGrad-CAM
methods.description: Gradient-based post-hoc feature attribution graph explainer that generates node-level saliency maps to highlight node-wise contribution towards an output task.

methods.name: GraphGrad-CAM++
methods.description: Gradient-based post-hoc feature attribution graph explainer that generates node-level saliency maps.

methods.name: GnnExplainer
methods.description: Node pruning-based post-hoc feature attribution graph explainer.

methods.name: GraphLRP
methods.description: Layer-wise relevance propagation post-hoc feature attribution graph explainer.
